verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents joining a live gdb session, reading live process state, and returning frame/file/line evidence before making changes, which supports debugging a live running program from the coding assistant — but this is scoped to C/C++ programs via gdb, not web-application-specific debugging (no browser/network/HTTP request inspection or web server runtime hooks are documented). Missing for 10: web-app-specific debugging tooling (browser devtools/network/log integration), independent/hands-on confirmation of the gdb bridge working in practice.
